semantics: Go 1.26, teaching subset (newer features checked against Go 1.27)

features.title: Variables and scopes
features.description: Declarations, assignments, constants and lexical shadowing.
features.diagnostic: not supported in gothik yet: Variables and scopes

features.title: Integer arithmetic
features.description: All integer widths through 64 bits, wraparound, shifts, bitwise operations and conversions; synthetic 64-bit int/uint/uintptr.
features.diagnostic: not supported in gothik yet: Integer arithmetic

features.title: Exact constants
features.description: Arbitrary integer and rational decimal arithmetic; binary/octal/hex integer notation. Hexadecimal float literals are not implemented.
features.diagnostic: not supported in gothik yet: Exact constants

features.title: Floating-point values
features.description: Nearest-even float32/float64 conversion from exact rationals, typed arithmetic and common decimal formatting. Uncommon native formatting corners remain Pending.
features.diagnostic: not supported in gothik yet: Floating-point values

features.title: Strings, bytes and runes
features.description: UTF-8 byte lengths, indexing, slicing, invalid byte sequences, byte/rune conversion and rune iteration. Full Unicode library APIs are not implemented.
features.diagnostic: not supported in gothik yet: Strings, bytes and runes

features.title: Functions and closures
features.description: Named functions, recursion, closures, multiple and named results, variadic functions, declared function types, method values and method expressions (T.Method, (*T).Method).
features.diagnostic: not supported in gothik yet: Functions and closures

features.title: Control flow
features.description: If/else, for, break, continue, expression and type switches, fallthrough, labels with break/continue on for/switch/select, goto within a function (jumps over declarations are not diagnosed); range over arrays, slices, maps, strings, integers, channels and iterator functions (func(yield func(...) bool), iter.Seq/Seq2), where break makes yield return false.
features.diagnostic: not supported in gothik yet: Control flow

features.title: Arrays, slices and maps
features.description: Arrays, slices, maps, sharing, comma-ok, append/copy/delete/make, comparable struct/array keys. Append capacity uses the minimum required; native growth and size-class rounding are not modeled.
features.diagnostic: not supported in gothik yet: Arrays, slices and maps

features.title: Pointers
features.description: Address-taking, dereference, new and identity. Addresses are synthetic.
features.diagnostic: not supported in gothik yet: Pointers

features.title: Goroutines and channels
features.description: Go statements, buffered/unbuffered channels, close, comma-ok and channel range. Deterministic cooperative teaching schedule by default; run options select a seeded random schedule, forced goroutine picks and read-modify-write preemption, and every choice point is recorded. Native parallel timing is not modeled.
features.diagnostic: not supported in gothik yet: Goroutines and channels

features.title: Synchronization
features.description: WaitGroup (including Go), Mutex/RWMutex (also embedded), Once, Cond, scalar and typed atomics as deterministic teaching operations. Copying synchronization values is rejected where unsupported.
features.diagnostic: not supported in gothik yet: Synchronization

features.title: Formatting and common libraries
features.description: fmt Print/Println/Printf/Sprint*/Fprint* (os.Stdout, os.Stderr, *strings.Builder) and Errorf with %w; verbs %v %+v %#v %T %d %s %q %x %X %o %b %c %U %t %p %e %f %g with width, precision and - + # 0 space flags applied per element like Go; maps print key-sorted; Error() and String() methods are honoured; time.Duration prints as 1.5s. Pointer addresses are synthetic.
features.diagnostic: not supported in gothik yet: Formatting and common libraries

features.title: Named types and structs
features.description: Named types (also local and grouped, declared in any order), structs, value/pointer and unnamed receivers, generic receivers, embedded fields with promotion of fields and methods through values and pointers, captured method values and unsafe measurement tools. Ambiguous promotions at equal depth are not diagnosed.
features.diagnostic: not supported in gothik yet: Named types and structs

features.title: Interfaces and typed nil
features.description: Empty and method interfaces, method sets including promoted methods, typed nil, assertions with comma-ok and type switches (multiple types per case, nil and default).
features.diagnostic: not supported in gothik yet: Interfaces and typed nil

features.title: Errors and wrapping
features.description: errors.New, Is, As, Unwrap and Join; fmt.Errorf with one or more %w; custom Unwrap() error / Unwrap() []error and Is(error) methods; strconv *NumError wrapping ErrSyntax/ErrRange.
features.diagnostic: not supported in gothik yet: Errors and wrapping

features.title: Defer, panic and recover
features.description: Deferred argument capture, reverse order, named-result updates, panic unwinding and direct recover. Full native panic rendering is Pending.
features.diagnostic: not supported in gothik yet: Defer, panic and recover

features.title: Generic functions and types
features.description: Generic functions, structs and methods on generic types, inference through slices, maps and function arguments, any/comparable and union/underlying-type constraints including named constraint interfaces.
features.diagnostic: not supported in gothik yet: Generic functions and types

features.title: Select and directional channels
features.description: Select/default, nil-channel waits, send/receive cases, seeded ready-case selection and directional channel parameters. Advanced selection corner cases require further coverage.
features.diagnostic: not supported in gothik yet: Select and directional channels

features.title: Virtual time and context
features.description: Virtual Sleep/After/Timer/Ticker/Now/Since, context cancellation/deadlines/values. No wall-clock, filesystem or network I/O.
features.diagnostic: not supported in gothik yet: Virtual time and context

features.title: Standard library subset
features.description: strings (Split/SplitN/Join/Fields/Repeat/Replace/Trim*/Index*/Contains*/Count/EqualFold/Cut/Map/case mapping, Builder), strconv (Itoa/Atoi/ParseInt/ParseUint/ParseFloat/ParseBool/Format*/Quote), sort (Ints/Strings/Float64s/Slice/SliceStable/Search/Sort/Stable/Reverse), slices (Sort/SortFunc/Contains/Index/Reverse/Max/Min/Equal/Insert/Delete/Compact/Clone/BinarySearch/Collect/Sorted/Values/All/Backward), maps (Keys/Values/All/Clone/Collect), cmp, unicode, unicode/utf8, math (functions and constants), math/rand on the seeded generator, os.Stdout/os.Stderr. sort.Slice and slices.SortFunc are stable here; map iterators follow insertion order rather than Go's randomized order.
features.diagnostic: not supported in gothik yet: Standard library subset
